description: Lists posts in the workspace: drafts, scheduled, published and failed. Use this to find drafts to schedule, to review the queue, or to find a post id for get_post, update_post or delete_post. Returns posts[] (id, status, type, title, content, mediaUrls, scheduledFor), nextCursor and hasMore. Refer to posts by title or caption when talking to the user; ids are for tool calls. Does NOT include per-account results; call get_post for those.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

from.description: ISO 8601 lower bound on the sort field.

sort.description: createdAt (default) or scheduledFor (only posts that have one).

to.description: ISO 8601 upper bound on the sort field.

name: list_posts

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; null when there is none.

title: List posts
